{{Short description|Indian state-owned company}} {{Use Indian English|date=May 2014}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2026}} {{Infobox company | name = Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited | logo = GujaratMineralDevelopmentCorporationLogo.jpg | type = [[Public company|Public]]
{{BSE|532181}} {{NSE|GMDCLTD}} | industry = Mining | founded = 1963 | hq_location_city = [[Ahmedabad]], Gujarat | num_locations = | area_served = Gujarat | key_people = {{Unbulleted list|[[Dr. Hasmukh Adhia]], Retd.IAS ([[Chairman]])|Roopwant Singh, IAS ([[Managing director]])|Ms Arti Kanwar, IAS ([[Company director|Secretary (EA), Finance Department]])}} | products = {{Unbulleted list|[[Lignite]]|[[Bauxite]]|Flourspar|[[Manganese]]|Silica Sand|[[Limestone]]|[[Bentonite]]|Ball Clay}} | revenue = {{up}}{{INRConvert|2734.79|c}}(FY2022) | operating_income = {{up}}{{INRConvert|580.57|c}}(FY2022) | net_income = {{up}}{{INRConvert|404.98|c}}(FY2022) | owner = [[Government of Gujarat]] | num_employees = {{Unbulleted list|class=nowrap| 1500+}} | Type = | hq_location_country = India | website = {{URL|http://www.gmdcltd.com/}} }} '''Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited''' ('''GMDC''') is a major Indian state-owned minerals and lignite mining company based in [[Ahmedabad]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.gmdcltd.com/showpage.aspx?contentid=1031 |title=GMDC LTD |access-date=15 May 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120709014213/http://www.gmdcltd.com/showpage.aspx?contentid=1031 |archive-date=9 July 2012 |url-status=dead }}[https://books.google.com/books?id=eMGgb5Nd_cgC&dq=Gujarat+Mineral+Development+Corporation+Limited.&pg=PA227 Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited] GMDC was founded in 1963. Its product range includes essential energy minerals like lignite, base metals and industrial minerals like bauxite and fluorspar. Gujarat government has given its green signal to GMDC to form a joint venture with [[National Aluminium Company|NALCO]] for a 1 mtpa refinery.{{cite news| url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/article3505725.ece | title=Gujarat minerals body gets govt nod for joint venture with Nalco | date=8 June 2012}} GMDC also owns and runs [[Akrimota Thermal Power Station]], a 250 MW (2x125 MW) lignite-based thermal power plant located in village [[Nanichher]] in [[Lakhpat | Lakhpat Taluka]], [[Kutch District]]. ==Product range== The company has grown in strength since its inception over the years. In 1963 the company commenced its operation with small silica sand quarry. In 1964 it started with bauxite mines in Kutch and now operates six bauxite mines. In 1971, a beneficiation plant was commissioned by GMDC to process 500 M.T of fluorspar ore and to produce [[calcium fluoride]] used for the manufacture of Hydro-fluoric acid and as flux in metallurgical industries. A captive mine at Ambadungar was established also to feed the plant. In 1976 lignite was discovered in Gujarat and GMDC started its first lignite mines at [[Panadhro]]. In 1980, a captive refining plant with copper mines was set up by GMDC near [[Ambaji]]. In 1983, another lignite mine was discovered & started by it at Rajpardi near [[Bharuch]]. In 1992, it established a calcination plant to add value to the bauxite mined by it at Gadhsisha in Kutch. In 1996, to use the lignite mined by it, GMDC also started thermal power plant at Nani-Chher in Kutch. In 2005 & 2009 more lignite mines were started by GMDC at [[Tadkeshwar]] near [[Surat]] and near [[Bhavnagar]], respectively. Also in 2006 it developed manganese ore mines at Shivarajpur in [[Panchmahal]]s. It is also setting up an Alumina plant with [[Raytheon]] Corporation of USA. As part of its Vocational Training Center (VTC) initiatives, GMDC implemented customized Extended Reality (XR) modules to enhance safety awareness and operator readiness for dumper operations.{{Cite web |title=XR-based Dumper Operations & Safety Training |url=https://radiumxr.com/xr-based-dumper-operations-safety-training-gmdc |website=RadiumXR |access-date=19 March 2026}} ===Akrimota Thermal Power Station=== '''Akrimota Thermal Power Station''' ({{coord|23.769788|68.645427|display=inline}}) is a [[lignite]]-based thermal power plant located in village [[Nanichher]] in [[Lakhpat | Lakhpat Taluka]], [[Kutch District]], [[Gujarat]]. The power plant is run by the Corporation. The power plant has an installed capacity of 250 MW (2x125 MW).{{Cite web |url=http://www.gmdcltd.com/projects/power.aspx |title=Power | Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Ltd |access-date=21 August 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140826161025/http://www.gmdcltd.com/projects/power.aspx |archive-date=26 August 2014 |url-status=dead }} {| class="sortable wikitable" ! Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited (GMDC) is a major Indian state-owned minerals and lignite mining company based in Ahmedabad. GMDC was founded in 1963.
Its product range includes essential energy minerals like lignite, base metals and industrial minerals like bauxite and fluorspar. Gujarat government has given its green signal to GMDC to form a joint venture with NALCO for a 1 mtpa refinery.
GMDC also owns and runs Akrimota Thermal Power Station, a 250 MW (2x125 MW) lignite-based thermal power plant located in village Nanichher in  Lakhpat Taluka, Kutch District.
